items.name: 01-raw-logs.png
items.note: A wall of raw deploy log lines in grey monospaced type, lower two-thirds of the frame. One line near the top of the block is marked red: a failed health check. The upper third is empty and dark. Usable as the problem shot. The lines are too small to read in full at phone size, which is the point.

items.name: 02-deploy-list.png
items.note: The deploy list. A panel headed Deploys with six rows: number, what it was, service, person, time. Lime dots for live, one amber row marked Rolled back. Sharp, and every row reads at phone size. The panel starts 40 percent down, so the upper third is free for a line.

items.name: 03-one-deploy.png
items.note: One deploy open. A very large 214, the service name, a lime Live in 42 s, then three changes with lines added and removed, and who merged it. The clearest single screen in the set. The lower fifth of the frame is empty.

items.name: 04-roll-back.png
items.note: A failed deploy with a red dot, a wide lime Roll back button with a cursor on it, and a ticked line saying the earlier deploy is live again. The button is the strongest lime element in any file. The lower quarter is empty.

items.name: 05-team-notes.png
items.note: Three notices stacked, the newest in front and two fading behind it. The front one says deploy 214 is live on api. Readable. The back two are low contrast on purpose.

items.name: 06-logo.png
items.note: The Brightdock mark, a lime rounded square with three dark bars, and the name under it, centred in the middle of the frame. Nothing else in frame. Usable as the closing card. The upper 40 percent and the lower 30 percent are empty.
